left_defects.translation: continues from previous page: but rather

left_defects.source: Vra autem [res publica] q i meliori cursu est
left_defects.translation: but rather the one that is in a better course

right_defects.source: autem eras / q i meliori cursu est ... ego bom consulam. Vale.
right_defects.translation: (entire remainder of the letter after the break omitted; jumps to next letter)

why: Right drops the whole rest of the crossing letter after the break; Left renders it, with only a stray bridging label.

right_defects.source: Si quis de me e alie dixerit: ut plus amico veteri q hominibus credas. Vale.

why: Right omits the sentence that completes the letter across the break; Left renders it.

left_defects.source: diligendis nulla de me rato hiea fuerit ... loquoz. Vale;

right_defects.source: diligendis nulla de me rato hiea fuerit ... loquoz. Vale;

why: Both drop the end of the crossing letter identically; other differences are minor.

left_defects.source: Capituli Patronis hunc eligere, quem credam futurum ... Sic me Deus adjuvet
left_defects.translation: (rest of the electors oath omitted; jumps to oath of the elected)

why: Left omits the continuation of the electors oath that crosses the break; Right renders it.
Both render the break region fully; Right also translates the running head, which is permitted.

left_defects.source: De profundis clamaui ad te domina: domina exaudi vocem meam
Domina non est exaltatum cor tuum: neque sublimati sunt oculi tui

right_defects.source: nos dna et conforta nos in gra tua: vt pte ante aspectu dni pntem

why: Left omits two verses before the break; Right omits only the line that completes the crossing verse, so Right loses less content, though Left reads on more continuously.

right_defects.translation: we beseech you, hear us, O mistress

why: Right expands the litany abbreviations with an added vocative and mistranslates illius; the break itself is handled equally.

left_defects.translation: I wish to be prompt to the pious reader

why: Both handle the crossing sentence well; each has small unrelated defects of similar weight.

left_defects.source: entschieden/er darff mir nicht die alten Secten auffdringen / ich habe derer Schrifften keine gesehen / es ist nur seine Bosheit.

why: Left drops the words that complete the crossing sentence of paragraph 190; Right renders them.
Break handled identically; Left mistranslates moreris (delay) before the break.

left_defects.source: impat? nos oibz rebz necessarijs instructissimi ... Vale;

left_defects.translation: He is busy with great affairs

right_defects.source: impat? nos oibz rebz necessarijs instructissimi ... Vale;

why: Both omit the end of the crossing letter; Left adds a mistranslation of the ships clause.

right_defects.source: paulomine hac tua iactura eē animo cōmotū q si
right_defects.translation: I am little moved ... just as if

why: Break handled equally; Right inverts paulominus ... quam.

right_defects.translation: inline Latin glosses beneficium, parochus, fabrica

why: Both render the break fully; Right only adds harmless Latin glosses.

right_defects.source: tui qui causam doloris mei assumpsisti
right_defects.translation: I, who have taken up the cause of my sorrow

why: Break equal; Right misreads the address to Christ and drops word/deed/thought.

right_defects.translation: that You do not punish me for them

why: Break equal; Right inverts the petition to be punished in this life.

right_defects.translation: gives you the fat of the wheat

why: Both render the crossing canticle fully; Left switches to line-by-line layout after the break.

left_defects.source: Christi naturam illam sua, neque mutat ... Subijcit autem aduersum nos.

right_defects.source: Christi naturam illam sua, neque mutat ... Subijcit autem aduersum nos.

why: Both drop the completion of the crossing sentence identically.

left_defects.source: durch andere Leute darzu angetrieben / damit fortzufahren
left_defects.translation: be driven forward by other people

why: Crossing sentence equal; Left garbles the clause about being urged to continue.
Break equal; Right mistranslates beatificatis and satietas after the break.
